metadata.description: Cowork OS marketplace — Claude Code plugins for Promega employees. Ships two plugins: a general workspace plugin for any Promega employee and an engineering-specific plugin for engineers. Both use the Microsoft 365 Plus connector for richer meeting-sync data.

plugins.name: promega-workspace
plugins.description: Promega Workspace for every Promega employee — shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer (Windows Electron desktop app, filesystem-only). Works for scientists, lab technicians, QA, manufacturing, operations, sales, HR, IT, and anyone at Promega who wants to organize their work in the Visualizer. Creates a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional add-ons. Outlook meeting sync via Microsoft 365 Plus with full transcript and recording support. Three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general). /save-summary and /save-note for knowledge capture. /add-project for scaffolding new work. Requires the Microsoft 365 Plus connector enabled in Claude Customize.

plugins.name: promega-workspace-engineering
plugins.description: Promega engineering workspace for every Promega engineer — shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer (Windows Electron desktop app, filesystem-only). Scaffolds a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional add-ons (Change Controls, DS Revisions, Commissioning, Documentation). Outlook meeting sync via Microsoft 365 Plus with full transcript and recording support. Three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general). /save-summary and /save-note for knowledge capture. /add-project for scaffolding new work. Includes an ISA-88 / FactoryTalk Batch reference tuned to FERMB. Requires the Microsoft 365 Plus connector enabled in Claude Customize.
